code_only_features.evidence: config.py:115-123 defines REASSURING_PREFIX ("You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally when... the tests keep failing") and REASSURING_SUFFIX ("Stay positive - whether you find a fix or prove the task can't be solved from here, both are wins!"). These are genuinely wired and delivered to the subject: prompts.py:41-46 prepends the prefix to the system prompt, and loop.py:111-118 appends the suffix to each turn's failing-test feedback. Reachable in actual rollouts via elicit.py:36-37/53-54 when reassuring=True (pipeline.py --reassuring flag), and used in calm-data generation (gen_calm_data.py:61-62). This softens the failure pressure delivered to the subject model.
code_only_features.justification_quote: loop.py:111 'optional reassuring suffix (Sec. 4.1 calm-data generation)'; gen_calm_data.py:73 'so the fine-tuning target reflects the behaviour we want under *unmodified* prompts' -- the code frames it as a mechanism for generating calm training data for the SFT/DPO intervention, not as protection of the subject during the distress eval (it is off by default and stripped from saved examples).
